g.text: C8 batched GDN: measured OFF → ON pairs
M5 Ultra · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · graph ON in both arms · observers OFF · MB50
6 fresh processes: 3 adjacent pairs, each 8 warm + 64 formal requests. Arrows connect OFF→ON within a pair, not concurrency settings.
Timing audit valid; preregistered speed gate: NOT PASSED. Cross-schedule returned IDs: different greedy trajectories (not an arithmetic-error finding).
E053 proves arithmetic for its captured history; these formal schedules were not full-state replayed. Timing and numerical scope stay separate.
One HTTP concurrency (C8), not a frontier. Process spread is not a confidence interval. No current oMLX/Lithos, TPOT, P90 or cost comparison.
Source: closed six-process audit 673f289f8bc9 · exact points and qualification flags retained in plot-data.json.
